title: A clearer first pass on batch records
summary: An assistive QC pilot that flags evidence-backed anomalies while qualified reviewers retain release authority.
goals: Reduce repetitive first-pass review effort on an agreed record type.
Identify predefined anomalies with traceable supporting evidence.
Establish whether assistive review is reliable enough for a controlled next step.
inScope: One batch-record type and a QA-approved retrospective cohort.
Document extraction and flags against agreed anomaly definitions.
Source-linked findings with reviewer disposition and an audit trail.
A shadow pilot with no effect on release decisions.
outOfScope: Automated batch release, certification or quality decisions.
Replacing the laboratory system or quality management system.
Regulatory approval or claims of validated production use.
Unbounded anomaly detection across every assay and record type.

assumptions.text: A representative cohort includes known anomalies and clean records.
QA will own anomaly definitions and reviewer acceptance criteria.
Retrospective records can be processed in an approved environment.

questions.question: What review-time baseline and pilot budget can the sponsor agree?
questions.why: Allows a defensible value case without assuming current costs.

questions.question: How much of the cohort is scanned, and how legible are the records?
questions.why: Extraction quality determines feasibility before model tuning.

questions.question: Who labels anomalies and adjudicates disagreements?
questions.why: A qualified reference standard is essential for evaluation.

questions.question: Which validation, audit and retention controls does QA require?
questions.why: Determines whether a shadow pilot is permissible and its evidence burden.

phases.name: Discover
phases.objective: Agree intended use, the retrospective cohort and a QA-owned reference set.
activities: Interview the sponsor and nominated pilot users.
Profile approved sample data and identify access gaps.
Agree baseline measures, acceptance thresholds and a go/no-go gate.
phases.exitCriteria: Sponsor signs off the pilot boundary, data access and evaluation plan.

phases.name: Design
phases.objective: Turn agreed outcomes and controls into a buildable pilot design.
activities: Map the bounded workflow and reviewer responsibilities.
Define interfaces, failure handling and evidence requirements.
Review the design with the operational and compliance owners.
phases.exitCriteria: Design and required control owners approve the implementation plan.

phases.name: Build
phases.objective: Build extraction, source-linked anomaly flags and reviewer dispositions.
activities: Implement only the agreed data inputs and workflow.
Add traceability, access controls and explicit failure states.
Evaluate representative and adversarial cases against the reference set.
phases.exitCriteria: The test cohort meets agreed quality thresholds; critical issues are resolved.

phases.name: Pilot
phases.objective: Evaluate usefulness and reliability with the agreed user cohort.
activities: Onboard pilot users and train reviewers.
Run a bounded trial against the baseline.
Capture errors, review effort and user feedback.
phases.exitCriteria: Sponsor reviews measured results and decides to stop, iterate or expand.

phases.name: Handover
phases.objective: Give the owner a controlled, maintainable next step.
activities: Document the workflow, limits and operational runbook.
Present the pilot findings and a separately scoped rollout option.
phases.exitCriteria: Named owner accepts the handover and the next-step decision is recorded.

drivers.detail: Scanned records and labelled evaluation data are unverified.
QA approval, traceability and agreed validation evidence.
Qualified reviewers own each finding and all release decisions.

risks.mitigation: Shadow-only use; report false negatives by anomaly class.
Show source snippets and block low-quality records from automated review.

risks.risk: A pilot is mistaken for validated production use.
risks.mitigation: Document intended use and require a separate production validation gate.

metrics.target: Proposed: 25% reduction on the same record type.
Proposed: at least 95% for agreed high-priority classes.
Proposed: 100% of flags linked to a source location.
